confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated cost-of-living data found in searches (Numbeo-type figures, mid-2026). They show a cappuccino at about €1.9, a domestic draught beer at about €4-6 and an inexpensive meal at about €15-18. Mid-range two-person meal estimates ranged widely, from about €36 to €72, so I used a middle value. Cocktail and wine come from sparse menu listings, about €7-9 for each, and I set them against the local beer price. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates for peak summer (July) and do not come from live listings. I converted from euros using an assumed EUR/USD rate of about 1.16. The RBA rate is the latest figure the search returned (18 Nov 2026), not a figure matched to July 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: Pisa is a mid-sized Tuscan university and tourist city. Its prices are close to the Italian national average, and its accommodation demand is driven by Florence and tower tourism.
